item.title: Boulder’s Lauren Jortberg headed to Milan Cortina Winter Olympics
item.description: Long before she drifted into the professional Nordic skiing sphere, Lauren Jortberg’s classmates at Boulder High School knew she was destined for something great.

item.title: Front Range prep events to watch this weekend
item.description: Now in Year 2 of the Granite Peaks League, Broomfield’s girls and Horizon’s boys have still yet to stumble. Can anyone catch them?

item.description: Nike called the subpoena a surprising escalation.

item.description: The agency announced the decision Wednesday but gave no reason for it.

item.title: Baylor uses dominant first half to crush CU Buffs
item.description: Hoping to recapture the competitive spark Colorado received from a reshuffled starting lineup earlier in the week, head coach Tad Boyle rolled with the same opening five at Baylor.

item.title: Nuggets blow past Nikola Jokic minutes restriction, but Jalen Brunson makes them pay in 2OT thriller
item.description: On the eve of the NBA trade deadline, the Denver Nuggets played a thriller with the New York Knicks at Madison Square Garden, but it was a costly one.
